name: com.eprfilinghq/epr-lookup
title: EPR Filing HQ: packaging EPR lookup
description: Read-only US packaging EPR lookup: CAA states, deadlines and estimated fees, with sources.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List the US states covered (CA, OR, CO, WA, MN, MD, plus ME monitored), with program status, law, agency and fee-schedule status.

tools.name: get_state_requirements
tools.description: Small-producer (de minimis) line, producer definition source, fee schedule status, upcoming dates and primary sources for one state.

state.description: Two-letter code or name: CA, OR, CO, WA, MN, MD or ME

tools.name: get_deadlines
tools.description: Dated report, fee, registration and program milestones, each with a source and a confidence label (confirmed, expected, secondary, approximate).

states.description: Filter by state codes; omit for all states

tools.name: estimate_fee
tools.description: Estimated 2027 fee range from CAA's published per-pound rates (OR, CO, WA) and optional flat dues (OR, CO), from annual pounds by material into one state. CA rates are preliminary and not totaled; MN, MD and ME have no published rates. Every figure is an estimate. Material ids: glass, aluminum, steel, corrugated, paperboard, kraft, polycoated, aseptic, pet_clear, pet_color, hdpe_natural, hdpe_color, pp_tubs, pp_lids, caps, pe_film, pp_film, laminate.

state.description: CA, OR, CO, WA, MN, MD or ME

lbs.description: Annual pounds of this material in packaging sold into the state

tools.name: check_applicability
tools.description: Given sales states, revenue band, California sales band, rough tonnage and role (brand owner, importer, private-label retailer), returns per state: may apply, may be outside a small-producer line, need figures, or monitored. Never a confirmed obligation.

revenue_band.description: Global revenue, most recent fiscal year

ca_sales.description: California gross sales, most recent calendar year

tonnage.description: Covered packaging into each state per year

tools.name: request_epr_check_info
tools.description: Returns how to request a free written EPR Check from EPR Filing HQ (form URL, email, what to send). Informational only: this tool does not submit, send or store anything.
